manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 186
text:
Page 001
001-1. ? Cute Little Star gifted a cute rabbit rocket 可爱小星 送了【萌兔火箭】X Cute Little Star gifted a cute rabbit rocket 送了【萌兔火箭】X 可爱小星 Cute Little Star gifted a cute rabbit rocket 可爱小星 送了【萌兔火箭】× Cute Little Star gifted a cute rabbit rock 可爱小星 送了【萌兔火箭】 ISN'T THIS TOO CRAZY?
001-2. THERE'S STILL A FEWMINUTES LEFT BEFORE IT'S 8 PM.
001-3. I SHOULD DO SOMETHING TO CELEBRATE..
001-4. RIGHT!

Page 002
002-1. WE FINALLY HIT 1600 RATING TODAY, IF WE CONTINUE TO PLAY IT MIGHT DROP, SO LET ME SHOW YOU MY TALENT FOR THE REST OF THE TIME.
002-2. End of Livestream

Page 003
003-1. ARE WE GOING TO BE RICH?!
003-2. HOWCOULD THERE BE SO MANY GIFTS...WE EVEN GAINED A DOZENMORE SLBS!
003-3. Pingping
003-4. I just took a look, there are several streams tonight recommending you!
003-5. There's also people talking about you on Tieba
003-6. T/N:Tieba is a Chinese online forum.
003-7. NO WONDER THERE WERE SO MANY PEOPLE WATCHING,I UNDERESTIMATED THE DIFFICLLTYOF REACHING 16OO RATING IN THE DUEL ARENA. IT'S PROBABLY ABOUTTO GO VIRAL, DON'T YOU HAVE ANYTHING TO SAY?
003-8. I HAVEN'T PLAYEDFOR SO LONG,SO I'M OUT OF THE LOOP.
003-9. SHE'S A PERSONFROM THE TANG DYNASTY PLAYING MODERN GAMES, YET SHE'S BETTER THAN THE VAST MAJORITYOF THE PEOPLE, HOW ABSURD IS THAT?
003-10. AH? DO I NEED TO SAY SOMETHING?

Page 004
004-1. _NO,I'M GOING TAKE OFF THE TO CHAINMAIL.
004-2. IF IT KEEPS GOING AT THIS RATE, WE CAN PROBABLY INSTALLAN AC IN THE STORAGE ROOM NEXT MONTH..RIGHT?
004-3. THAT WAYWE CAN SEPERATE..
004-4. FORGET IT! IT'S MORECOST-EFFECTIVE TO SAVE MONEYAND BUY IT'S NOT BECAUSE I DELICIOUS FOOD! DONT WANT TOMOVE~

Page 005
005-1. WHYDON'T YOU BECOME A SINGER?
005-2. YOU CAN MAKE A LOT OF MONEY, AND YOU CAN ALSO BE ON TV.DOESN'T LITTLE YAN LIKE BEING ON TV?
005-3. WHY WOULD I BECOME A SINGER?
005-4. I JUST HAVE A LITTLE BITOFTALENT LITTLE BIT OF TALENT, I HAVE NO PROFESSIONAL TRAINING, AND I DON'T LIKE BEING A STAR.
005-5. I JUST FEEL THAT KNOWING MUSICISVERY USEFUL.
005-6. THAT'S TRUE, KNOWING HOW'TO PICK MUSIC WOULD BE HELPFUL FOR EDITING.
005-7. IT FEELS SO GOOD TAKINGOFF THECHAINMAIL,ICAN'T PUT IT ON RANDOMLY IN THE FUTURE.

Page 006
006-1. ITS NOT MEANT FOR SUMMER AT ALL, MY CLOTHES ARE THIN SO IT'S BASICALLY STUCK TO THE SKIN, PRESSING ON MY SHOULDERS.
006-2. AS FOR QIN HAO, HE WAS EXCITED TO WEAR IT, SO HE DIDN'T FEEL UNCOMFORT- ABLE AT ALL.
006-3. WHATARE YOU DOING?!
006-4. I UNDRESSED TO GO SHOWER. BEEN WEARING IT FOR A WHILE, SO I'M A LITTLE HOT.

Page 007
007-1. THIS GUY IS SHIRTLESS AND LOOKS KINDA...
007-2. KINDA...
007-3. ROBUST, iSN'T IT?
007-4. PERVERT!
007-5. THAT.'SHOWTHEYDO IT IN THE TV SHOWS~ WHAT'S THE MATTER,DIDN'T THE ANCIENT PEOPLE HAVE TO BE SHIRT- LESS WHEN DOING FARMWORK?
007-6. EVERYTHING ON TV IS FAKE.
007-7. FAKE?
007-8. OF COURSE.
007-9. IF YOU DON'T WEAR CLOTHES, YOU'LL DIE FROM THE SLN. NOT ONLY DO YOU HAVE TO WEAR THEM, BUTYOU ALSO HAVE'TO WEAR A STRAW HAT FOR MORE COVER.
007-10. IREALLY WANT TO POKE A FEW TIMES...

Page 008
008-1. LET'S NOT THINK ABOUT THAT,
008-2. TOMORROW IS MONDAY AGAIN, IF I WANT TO PLAY GAMES, I HAVETO A FEW PAGES OFQUESTIONS. I'LLTAKE THIS TIME TO PLAY SOME MORE~
008-3. T/N: Xiao Ming is a character from the math problem if you forgot.
008-4. DON'TLET ME SEE XIAO MING IN THE FUTURE!
008-5. Enter
008-6. BUT,
008-7. THAT GUY'S CHEST JUST NOW WAS REALLY ROBUST...

Page 009
009-1. WHAT AM I THINKING!?
009-2. IF YOU PLAY SO BADLY, YOU WON'T HAVE ANY FRIENDS.
009-3. YOUSHOULD DO THIS HERE..
009-4. SOMETHING IS WRONG WITH ME... IT'S SO WEIRD...
009-5. DID YOU DRUG ME?
